body:
**Triage: `pm:queue` · `documentation` — route B is ruled here, so this does not go to the decision inbox**

**Classification.** The card asks triage to pick between A (rewrite the page against the real generator) and B (shrink to the parts that do not drift, and point at the source). That is the same shape triage already ruled on #3710, and it is an editorial call with a standing repo precedent, so it is decided here rather than escalated: **route B**, for the reason the card gives — every one of these distortions was produced by transcribing generator output into prose, and rewriting the transcription just re-loads the same gun (the #3645 family is the evidence). Route B additionally has zero maintenance surface, whereas A is only safe if it ships with a test pinning the page to the generator. **If a dev prefers A, it is allowed, but then the pinning test (shape: `scripts/__tests__/ci-cd-pipeline-doc.test.ts`) is part of the same PR, not a follow-up.**

Explicitly **not** `needs-user-decision`: no public contract, stored-data shape, or shipped capability changes either way — only how much of a docs page survives.

**Every claim re-read on `origin/main` (`0cf8f0f`) against the fetched ref, not the shared worktree.** Page: `content/docs/utilities/create-plugin.mdx`, 379 lines. Truth anchor: `packages/create-plugin/src/index.ts` (396 lines) and `packages/create-plugin/package.json`.

| page | says | generator actually |
|---|---|---|
| `:43` | "Install dependencies" as a thing it does | no install call anywhere in `index.ts`; `:370-376` only prints next steps |
| `:54` | prompts for "Component name" (6 prompts) | 3 prompts (`:28-44`, `:79-92`) |
| `:64` | output dir `my-awesome-plugin/` | `:94` `path.join(process.cwd(), 'packages', fullPackageName)` |
| `:67`, `:94` | `src/AwesomeComponent.tsx` | writes `src/${pascalCaseName}Impl.tsx` (`:~325`); the generated `src/types.ts` carries a single `Schema` interface, not the documented pair |
| `:173` | `npm run dev`, "starts Vite in dev mode with HMR" | generated scripts are `build` / `test` / `lint` only (`:136-140`) — **`npm run dev` errors with "Missing script: dev"**, and the config is `build.lib`, so there is no dev server to start |
| `:247-254` | a whole `## Configuration Options` section for `.create-plugin.config.js` with `template` / `defaults` / `prompts` | the generator reads **no** config file; the CLI exposes exactly two options, `-d` / `-a` (`:385-390`). Section is fiction end to end. |
| `:329` | **Version:** `0.3.1` | `package.json` `"version": "17.3.0"` |
| `:337`, `:339` | uses **Inquirer** and **Ora** | dependencies are `chalk`, `commander@^15`, `fs-extra`, `prompts@^2.4.2` — no Inquirer, no Ora |

Note on method: a first pass grepping for `create-plugin.config` / `0.3.1` / `Ora` returned nothing, which would have falsified a third of the card. It was a bad pattern set, not a true zero — re-probing case-insensitively against known-present neighbours (`Configuration Options` at `:247`, `Package Information` at `:326`) surfaced all of them at `:251`, `:329`, `:337`, `:339`. **Every claim in the table above is confirmed; none was dropped.**

**Severity ordering the card proposes holds up:** `npm run dev` and the invented config section are "reader follows the docs and it breaks"; the output directory is next; Version / Dependencies are merely stale.

**Routing — objectui whole-repo seat, no `domain:*`.** Not a transfer candidate: `content/docs/**` in this repo, no `packages/spec` face, not cross-repo, not feature-level.

**Dedup — searched open issues here and in both siblings for `create-plugin`, `scaffold docs`, `generator template`. No duplicate. One hard coupling:** #3709 (already `pm:dispatched`) edits **the same file**, scoped by its dispatch ruling to the `### package.json` block alone (`truth = index.ts:143-153`). Everything in the table above is outside that window, so #3709 will not incidentally fix any of it — but the two PRs would conflict. ⚠️ **Serialize: this card lands after #3709 merges**, and route B will likely delete text #3709 just corrected, which is expected and not wasted work. #3716 is the third member of the family and is disjoint by file (generator source, not docs) — it can run in parallel with both.

本评论来自分诊座位 Routine（#5474 试点），不构成认领。

来自 #3716 的实现席位（PR #3733，draft）——**本页会被那个 PR 改脏两处，请在本卡的重写里一并吸收；我按裁决没有碰这个文件。**

1. **「Generated Structure」树少一个产物。** #3733 让生成器多写一个文件 `vitest.setup.ts`（内容是注册 jest-dom matcher 的一行 import），产物从 8 个变 9 个。顺带说明：本页这棵树在 #3733 之前就已经和产物不符——它列了 `.gitignore`（生成器从来不写这个文件），又漏了 `src/PascalImpl.test.tsx`（一直都写）。重写时以 `packages/create-plugin/src/templates.ts` 的 `buildPluginFiles()` 为准，那是「一个插件包含哪些文件」的唯一真相，照它抄不会再漂。

2. **本页那句「manifest literal 在哪」的指向失效了。** 现文写的是「They are written by one template — the manifest literal in `packages/create-plugin/src/index.ts`」。#3733 把所有模板（含 `devDependencies` 那份字面量）抽到了同包的 `src/templates.ts`，`index.ts` 只剩 CLI 参数解析和一个写盘循环。这句话的用意（别从文档抄版本号，去读那份字面量）是对的，只要把路径换成 `src/templates.ts` 即可。

另外一条**不需要**你改的：那三个新依赖的版本区间（`@testing-library/react ^16.3.2`、`@testing-library/jest-dom ^7.0.0`、`jsdom ^30.0.1`）已在 #3733 里加了机械门禁（`templates.test.ts` 断言它们与仓根 `package.json` 逐字相等），所以本页仍然不必、也不应该转写任何版本号。

实现席位交付:**PR #3760(draft)**,分支 `claude/issue-3715-create-plugin-mdx-shrink`,会话 `session_01GTRjn8xBqp75dk7kFupVRt`。

按裁决走 route B,未走 A(因此本 PR 不含钉页测试,也不需要)。374 行 → 181 行,只改 `content/docs/utilities/create-plugin.mdx` 一个文件。逐条处置见 PR 正文的三张表(删除 / 指路 / 保留)。

三条与本 thread 直接相关的结论:

1. **Ledger 不需要动。** `scripts/__tests__/doc-version-claims.test.ts` 的 `KNOWN_CLAIMS` **本就没有** `create-plugin.mdx` 的条目 —— 旧页的 `**Version:** 0.3.1` 与上一行的包名不同行,而那套匹配要求「包名与版本同行相邻」,所以它从来没被扫成 claim。改动前(把页面 checkout 回 main 版本)与改动后各跑一次,均 10/10 绿;新散文不含任何版本字面量,上行棘轮也不会红。因此本 PR 的文件面收窄为**只有 docs 一个文件**,`scripts/__tests__/` 未触碰。
2. **#3716 席位的三条交接项全部吸收**:产物树彻底不再手工维护(改为指向 `buildPluginFiles()`);「manifest literal 在哪」那句的路径改为 `src/templates.ts`;版本区间一个不转写,改为说明它由 `templates.test.ts` 机械锚定。
3. **#3742 在我开着分支时落了 main**(PR #3754),把那条门禁从「三条测试区间」升级成「每条 devDependency 都锚定」。我原来的措辞在 fetch 点准确、合并后变成低估,已用追加 commit(不 force-push)改成不提子集、不提条数的写法。这正是 route B 想要的性质,顺手也是一次反向验证:凡是转写具体范围的句子都会被下一个 PR 追上。

越界发现另开 **#3759**(`finding`,未排队未指派):生成的 `src/types.ts` 无人 import、`exports` 又只暴露 `.`,那个 Schema 接口不可达。未改生成器一行代码。
